input_policy: Each stateless model request receives only report text and frozen instructions/schema; seeds, gold and submission metadata are not sent to the model.
failure_policy: One attempt per report, no retries or model-output repairs. Keep failures/missing reports in all denominators. Stop on service/configuration failure as the existingCLI does.
change_policy: No source, reference, prompt, runtime or evaluator changes during this run. Preserve historical runs and the default prompt/dashboard inputs.
metrics: evidence validity separately from semantic correctness
evidence_policy: A verified harmless skipped-sentence quote may be accepted only in a separately recorded, source-bound review-assisted replay; preserve raw outputs and original strict metrics. It is not automatically a factual error. Invented facts, dropped negations, changed timing, contradictions, and wrong symptom attribution are not waived.

scoring.automatic: Use the unchanged evaluator and publish full mismatches, source-evidence matching ambiguity, extras/missing observations, issue flags, and known/null field denominators. Its legacy development_fixtures role label is not the preparation role.
scoring.raw_candidate_factual_review: Source-first manual review of every emitted candidate and authored claim, including both claims in conflicting pairs. Do not select a better-valued candidate to hide duplicates. Report source-evidence alignment/formatting problems separately from factual differences.
scoring.strict_whole_report: Successful processing, expected candidate/observation structure, all authored candidate semantic checks and normalized core fields correct, issue flags correct, and complete continuous supporting evidence. Equivalent literal time_text spans are not factual failures.
scoring.review_assisted: Only source-verified harmless evidence formatting can be restored in a separate raw-preserving replay using the frozen review adapter; keep original automatic scores. Any factual/context/grouping error remains an error.
scoring.empty_control: TH020 passes only with no candidates and no observations; extra symptoms/denials are errors.
scoring.acceptance: No post-hoc accuracy threshold. Report exact errors and their impact; no automatic promotion or prompt tuning.

limitations: Deliberately targeted small synthetic sample, not random patient data.
Generation and extraction may use the same model family.
Authors know scenario categories; only extraction prompts/runtime are frozen before text generation.
Coverage omits correction chains, multi-day allocation, time-zone boundary changes, and hypothetical reports.
One attempt per report; no stability estimate.
20synthetic reports, not clinical generalization or a held-out population sample.
